meta.title: Denison Silva — Ballet Dancer, Teacher & Choreographer in Berlin
meta.description: Ballet dancer, ballet and jazz teacher and choreographer in Berlin. Classes for children, teens and adults — fifteen years on stage in five countries.

hero.heading: Denison Silva — ballet dancer, ballet and jazz teacher and choreographer in Berlin

about.title: About
about.lead: Fifteen years on stage, and the last six of them in rehearsal rooms with dancers who are only just starting. Both are the same job: finding the movement that says the thing.
about.p1: I trained in São Paulo and Vancouver and joined Ballet Nacional del Sodre in Montevideo under Julio Bocca at twenty. Since then I have danced in Buenos Aires, across France, and in five German houses — Halberstadt, Flensburg, Detmold, Hof and Neustrelitz.
about.p2: Since 2023 most of my work has been choreography and teaching: evening-length productions for youth companies, classical and contemporary classes for children, teenagers and adults, and inclusive workshops in schools and daycare centres. I teach in four languages and fit the training to the dancer in front of me.
about.p3: Discipline first, because discipline is what buys a dancer their freedom. Then storytelling. Then the part that matters most — that they leave the studio a little larger than they walked in.

items.berlinballet: One of the Mice in the midnight battle and the Woodcutter in The Nutcracker at Kino Babylon, where a film becomes a live ballet. World premiere on 18 December 2026.

items.tanzoffensive: Classical ballet and contemporary dance for mixed-age, mixed-level groups, alongside choreographic work on evening-length productions with artistic director Doris Neff.
items.tanzkompanie: Dancer in the operetta Die Csárdásfürstin.
items.jungestheaterhof: Ran the ballet, jazz and contemporary programme for more than 80 students, and led inclusive workshops for over 600 children in schools and daycare centres.
items.nyc: Resident choreographer: repertoire, music, lighting and costume from the first idea to opening night, plus the daily coaching that gets young dancers there.
items.theaterhof: Company dancer in Die Geschöpfe des Prometheus, Ballet Blanc and the chamber-ballet evenings.
items.detmold: Danced Sacra, The Jungle Book and the gala programmes, and created The Beauty of Oxum for the company.

items.halberstadt: Classical and contemporary repertoire, including Hänsel und Gretel and Carmen.

items.sodre: Ensemble and soloist under Julio Bocca, in works by Balanchine, Duato, Makarova, Wainrot, Nebrada, Holmes, Bazilis and Hynd.

work.title: Productions
work.lead: The same career told three ways, because most people arrive here looking for one of them.
work.dancer: Dancer in the operetta Die Csárdásfürstin (Deutsche Tanzkompanie), in productions including Die Geschöpfe des Prometheus, Ballet Blanc and chamber-ballet evening formats (Theater Hof), Sacra, The Jungle Book and various ballet galas (Landestheater Detmold), Schwanensee, Heidi — Das Familienballett, the Nutcracker reprise and gala programmes (Schleswig-Holsteinisches Landestheater Flensburg), classical and contemporary repertoire including Hänsel und Gretel and Carmen (Nordharzer Städtebundtheater Halberstadt), a season tour through Paris, Cannes, Nantes, Roubaix, Montpellier and Toulouse (Ballets de France), repertoire by Frederick Ashton (Ballet Nacional de Argentina, Buenos Aires), and works by George Balanchine, Nacho Duato, Mauricio Wainrot, Vicente Nebrada, Anna-Marie Holmes, Silvia Bazilis, Natalia Makarova and Ronald Hynd as ensemble dancer and soloist (Ballet Nacional del Sodre, Montevideo).
work.teacher: Teacher of classical ballet and contemporary dance for mixed-age and mixed-level groups — children, teenagers and adults — in group and private classes, with rehearsal direction for company productions (Tanzoffensive Berlin), coordination of the pedagogical and artistic programme in ballet, jazz and contemporary dance for more than 80 students, plus inclusive workshops for over 600 children in schools and daycare centres (Junges Theater Hof), coaching of young dancers through the technical and artistic demands of each production (North German Performing Arts Youth Company, Flensburg), and guest ballet teaching developing young dancers' technical and artistic skills (Brazil).
work.choreographer: Choreographer for evening-length productions including A Midsummer Night's Dream, developing movement material and contributing to the artistic development of each piece (Tanzoffensive Berlin), Grüne Träume, graue Zukunft as end-of-year production (Junges Theater Hof), Ellis in the Wonder World Water and Spelunkerwirt as resident choreographer with full responsibility for the creative process from repertoire development to music, lighting and costume concept, with an invitation to the Detmold Ballet Gala 2025 (North German Performing Arts Youth Company, Flensburg), The Beauty of Oxum created for the professional company (Landestheater Detmold), and guest choreographic work with young dancers (Brazil).

nutcracker.title: The Nutcracker
nutcracker.metaTitle: The Nutcracker at Kino Babylon Berlin — Denison Silva
nutcracker.description: Denison Silva dances one of the Mice and the Woodcutter in the Berlin Ballet Company’s Nutcracker at Kino Babylon, Berlin. World premiere 18 December 2026.
nutcracker.lead: Denison Silva as one of the Mice and as the Woodcutter — in the Berlin Ballet Company’s Nutcracker at Kino Babylon, Berlin.
nutcracker.p1: Two roles at opposite ends of the evening. As one of the Mice, Denison fights on the Mouse King’s side when the clock strikes midnight: fast, sharp character dancing in a pack, where the timing of the whole group carries the scene. As the Woodcutter he changes register completely — a grounded character role that asks for presence and clear storytelling rather than speed.
nutcracker.p2: He knows the work from the inside: he danced The Nutcracker at the Schleswig-Holsteinisches Landestheater in Flensburg. This time it is in his home city, in a production where a film turns into live ballet in a 1920s cinema. Choreography by Alexander Abdukarimov and Arshak Ghalumyan; dates and tickets are on the Berlin Ballet Company’s page.

cop17.title: COP17 Opening Show
cop17.metaTitle: Denison Silva at the COP17 Opening Show, Yerevan 2026
cop17.description: Denison Silva danced in the ensemble and a solo at the COP17 opening show in Yerevan on 18 October 2026 — a show about saving nature. Photos, video, credits.
cop17.lead: Ensemble, a solo and the group’s rehearsal coordination: Denison Silva at the opening show of the UN Biodiversity Conference in Yerevan, 18 October 2026.
cop17.p1: The show was about saving nature — and about how humanity came to be. It traced how we treat the planet today: using up its resources and destroying it, because people think only of themselves and not of each other, of nature or of the animals they share it with.
cop17.p2: Denison danced in the ensemble and performed a solo of his own, which begins at 9:30 in the recording below. Off stage he took on the rehearsal coordination studio for the group from Berlin: the music, the logistics and the travel of the dancers to Yerevan and back.
